---
format: revealjs
filters: [explain, stepper]
title: layout-valign aligns the steps too
---

## Top

The caption stack gets `gravity-top`: the short step sits at the top edge of
the box the long one spans, level with the code.

::: {.explain-code layout-valign="top"}
```{.go}
row := b.freeRow(col)
if row < 0 {
	return ErrColumnFull
}
```

:::: {lines="1"}
Short.
::::

:::: {lines="2-4"}
A long one.

It has a second paragraph, so the stack is as tall as this.
::::
:::

## Bottom, with `.below`

::: {.explain-code .below layout-valign="bottom"}
```{.go}
row := b.freeRow(col)
```

:::: {lines="1"}
Short.
::::

:::: {}
A long one.

It has a second paragraph.
::::
:::
